description: A Dart class representing a todo task with properties such as id, title, completion status, and creation date. The class includes methods for copying, serialization to a map, and deserialization from a map, facilitating database operations.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: A class modeling a todo task with properties for id, title, completion status, and creation timestamp. Includes methods for copying instances, converting to a map for database interactions, and creating instances from database maps.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the task with optional changes to its properties.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Converts the Task instance to a Map<String, dynamic> suitable for database storage.

methods.name: fromMap
methods.description: Creates a Task instance from a database map row.
